Garnet, ivory, red-blue-orange and navy mini dresses are paired with varied heels, rainbow footwear and visible arm tattoos. The opaque mini dresses have a closer, shorter tailored fit.

AI-generated portrait of four fictional adult women gathered closely on an apricot couch beside tall city-facing windows. The braided woman reclines against cushions while the blonde and two dark-haired women lean toward her, exchanging a shoulder touch and hand contact. Charcoal, apricot, pearl and plum garments, rainbow hosiery and RAZE, GRD and scorpion arm motifs are visible.

Distant smoke and a mushroom-shaped cloud are imaginary, not a real event.
